description: Registered Onsite Wastewater Treatment System (OWTS) Installers List is a dataset listed in State of Missouri open data portal (data.mo.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Missouri. Coverage: Missouri. The portal files it under the category Health. The table has 11 columns. The portal shows 2026-03-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-mo-gov-portal.
